notes.title: Anomaly Hunter (Free Demo) - sci-fi hidden object puzzler about time-travelling detective, Q4 2020
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301820/Anomaly_Hunter/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31263647/4464c0426ed107262061a73f6edcb3ff41c11eff.png[/img][/url]

[b]Anomaly Hunter[/b] - sci-fi hidden object puzzler about time-traveling detective.
This is first game by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/pub/hook][b]Hook Games[/b][/url] (ex Konstructors), so we would really appreciate your support.

Play as STID (Space & Time Integrity Department) detective, whose role is to find & fix time anomalies, which cause a lot of trouble all over the universe.

Why do they appear, who is hiding behind all of this - simple accident or evil villain? That's a mystery to solve.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301820/Anomaly_Hunter/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31263647/d50b2b7cb4e876ae4d33cdb4e110e73087e7b4e1.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]15 original detailed worlds
    [*]Over 3 hours of fascinating gameplay
    [*]1000+ unique characters and objects, each with its story to tell
    [*]English, Chinese, German, Spanish, Ukrainian & Russian localizations
    [*]Gazillion of Easter eggs, most of them you won't find anyway ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
[/list]

[h1]Play free Demo & Wishlist:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301820/Anomaly_Hunter/

Hook Games[/i]

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31263647/3bf2beb996ccbebbb9268b76738cb798e25bd9fd.png[/img]

[h1]Game contains Sudoku Universe, Sudoku Jigsaw & Sudoku Killer.[/h1]

[b]Play your ultimate sudoku game any time any where![/b]

Sudoku - is a logic-based, combinatorial number-placement puzzle. The objective is to fill a 9×9 grid with digits so that each column, each row, and each of the nine 3×3 subgrids that compose the grid (also called "boxes", "blocks", or "regions") contains all of the digits from 1 to 9.

notes.title: Wayout and Lines X coming to Nintendo Switch
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31263647/d515ca4457d2654b9dfa261d31459f61ec126532.jpg[/img]
[h1]Wayout release date - [b]July 11, 2019[/b][/h1]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uGU_YI0ejxY]Youtube trailer[/url]
[u]eShop[/u] - link N/A yet, but you can find it in eShop on device.

WayOut - beautiful & challenging grid-based puzzle.
Turn off the grid by pushing all the buttons in the right order and find a WayOut of this puzzle. It's not as easy as it sounds. ;)
Casual puzzle fans will have to scratch their heads every now and then. As for hardcore puzzle fans, this one's a definite treat.

- Combination of new and classic Lights Out gameplay
- 60+ handcrafted levels
- 6 chapters, each with their unique set of puzzle mechanics
- Abstract artstyle with minimalistic approach
- Ambient soundtracks grants beautiful relaxing atmosphere
